characters.name: Kim Rider
characters.description: Chiến binh mặt nạ giáp đỏ ánh kim, visor vàng, chuyên cận chiến tốc độ.
characters.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="512" height="700" viewBox="0 0 512 700" fill="none">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="skinGradient" x1="180" y1="150" x2="330" y2="420">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FFE9D2"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#FFCDAA"/>
    </linearGradient>

    <linearGradient id="hairGradient" x1="180" y1="90" x2="330" y2="210">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#6B4228"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#432716"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="hairBackGradient" x1="150" y1="90" x2="365" y2="230">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#6B4228"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#432716"/>
    </linearGradient>

    <linearGradient id="helmetGradient" x1="170" y1="80" x2="340" y2="230">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#E23B3B"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#8E1F1F"/>
    </linearGradient>

    <linearGradient id="visorGradient" x1="191" y1="146" x2="321" y2="236">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FFD24D"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#C98A00"/>
    </linearGradient>

    <linearGradient id="shirtGradient" x1="170" y1="330" x2="340" y2="500">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#3A3A42"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#1C1C22"/>
    </linearGradient>

    <linearGradient id="pantsGradient" x1="190" y1="475" x2="330" y2="650">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#E23B3B"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#8E1F1F"/>
    </linearGradient>

    <linearGradient id="shoeGradient" x1="180" y1="637" x2="332" y2="674">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#2B2B31"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#151519"/>
    </linearGradient>

    

    <filter id="softShadow" x="-50%" y="-50%" width="200%" height="200%">
      <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="7"/>
    </filter>

    <filter id="objectShadow" x="-50%" y="-50%" width="200%" height="200%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="5" stdDeviation="5" flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity="0.12"/>
    </filter>

    <filter id="headShadow" x="-50%" y="-50%" width="200%" height="200%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="3" stdDeviation="3" flood-color="#8E1F1F" flood-opacity="0.2"/>
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="8" stdDeviation="8" flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity="0.08"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <g id="avatar">

    <!-- 01. GROUND SHADOW -->
    <g id="shadow">
      <ellipse cx="256" cy="665" rx="105" ry="22" fill="#000000" opacity="0.10" filter="url(#softShadow)"/>
    </g>

    

    
    <!-- ===================================================
         02. BACK HAIR / HELMET BACK
    ==================================================== -->
    <g id="hair-back">
      <path
        d="
          M172 207
          C145 180 151 124 184 99
          C204 83 230 77 256 78
          C291 77 322 91 340 116
          C365 151 359 193 337 216
          L310 234
          L201 230
          Z
        "
        fill="url(#helmetGradient)"
      />
    </g>

    <!-- ===================================================
         03. HEAD
    ==================================================== -->
    <g id="head" filter="url(#headShadow)">

      <!-- Neck -->
      <path
        d="M226 292 L226 329 C226 345 286 345 286 329 L286 292 Z"
        fill="url(#skinGradient)"
      />
      <path
        d="M226 293 C238 307 272 309 286 293 L286 317 C268 326 242 326 226 316 Z"
        fill="#00000022"
      />

      <!-- Helmet dome (replaces face+hair) -->
      <path
        d="
          M179 164
          C179 115 213 91 256 91
          C299 91 333 115 333 164
          L333 216
          C333 263 299 301 256 301
          C213 301 179 263 179 216
          Z
        "
        fill="url(#helmetGradient)"
      />

      <!-- Helmet highlight -->
      <ellipse cx="224" cy="140" rx="42" ry="26" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.22"/>

      <!-- Visor -->
      <path
        d="
          M191 178
          C191 158 210 146 256 146
          C302 146 321 158 321 178
          L321 205
          C321 224 300 236 256 236
          C212 236 191 224 191 205
          Z
        "
        fill="url(#visorGradient)"
      />
      <!-- Visor scan-line highlight -->
      <path
        d="M198 168 C220 156 292 156 314 168"
        stroke="#FFFFFF"
        stroke-width="4"
        stroke-linecap="round"
        opacity="0.35"
        fill="none"
      />
      <!-- Visor center ridge -->
      <path d="M256 146 L256 236" stroke="#8E1F1F" stroke-width="5" opacity="0.5"/>

      <!-- Antennae / helmet fins -->
      
          <path d="M204 96 L196 68" stroke="#8E1F1F" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/>
          <path d="M308 96 L316 68" stroke="#8E1F1F" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/>
          <circle cx="196" cy="66" r="5" fill="#FFD24D"/>
          <circle cx="316" cy="66" r="5" fill="#FFD24D"/>
        

      <!-- Ear guards -->
      <ellipse cx="181" cy="215" rx="11" ry="20" fill="url(#helmetGradient)"/>
      <ellipse cx="331" cy="215" rx="11" ry="20" fill="url(#helmetGradient)"/>
      <ellipse cx="184" cy="210" rx="4" ry="12" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.25"/>
      <ellipse cx="328" cy="210" rx="4" ry="12" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.25"/>

      <!-- Visor glass sheen -->
      <ellipse cx="220" cy="172" rx="16" ry="8" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.45"/>
    </g>


    <!-- 06. BODY -->
    <g id="body">
      <!-- Left arm -->
      <path
        d="M190 354 C166 354 157 371 158 395 L162 465 C163 480 175 490 188 486 C201 482 205 470 204 456 L201 386 Z"
        fill="url(#skinGradient)"
      />
      <!-- Right arm -->
      <path
        d="M322 354 C346 354 355 371 354 395 L350 465 C349 480 337 490 324 486 C311 482 307 470 308 456 L311 386 Z"
        fill="url(#skinGradient)"
      />

      <!-- Suit / Shirt -->
      <path
        d="
          M209 326
          C221 318 237 314 256 314
          C275 314 291 318 303 326
          C327 331 342 349 340 372
          L334 470
          C333 489 320 501 301 501
          L211 501
          C192 501 179 489 178 470
          L172 372
          C170 349 185 331 209 326
          Z
        "
        fill="url(#shirtGradient)"
        filter="url(#objectShadow)"
      />

      <!-- Collar -->
      <path d="M225 324 C232 344 280 344 287 324" stroke="#8E1F1F" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round"/>

      <!-- Chest emblem -->
      
          <path d="M256 350 L270 375 L256 400 L242 375 Z" fill="#E23B3B" opacity="0.9"/>
          <circle cx="256" cy="375" r="6" fill="#FFD24D"/>
        

      <!-- Suit highlight -->
      <path d="M201 361 C195 389 196 438 201 465" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="12" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.4"/>

      
          <rect x="196" y="470" width="120" height="18" rx="8" fill="#2B2B31"/>
          <circle cx="256" cy="479" r="13" fill="#FFD24D" stroke="#8E1F1F" stroke-width="3"/>
        

      <!-- Cape (vẽ sau cùng, phủ lên vai, bay ra sau lưng) -->
      
    </g>

    <!-- 07. PANTS -->
    <g id="pants">
      <path
        d="M194 492 L256 492 L256 632 C256 647 246 655 230 655 L203 655 C190 655 184 645 186 631 Z"
        fill="url(#pantsGradient)"
        filter="url(#objectShadow)"
      />
      <path
        d="M256 492 L318 492 L326 631 C328 645 320 655 307 655 L280 655 C264 655 256 647 256 632 Z"
        fill="url(#pantsGradient)"
        filter="url(#objectShadow)"
      />
      <path d="M256 500 L256 633" stroke="#8E1F1F" stroke-width="5" opacity="0.7"/>
      <path d="M211 510 L208 620" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.25"/>
    </g>

    <!-- 08. SHOES / BOOTS -->
    <g id="shoes">
      <path
        d="M188 642 C202 637 224 637 243 642 C254 645 260 654 255 663 C251 671 236 674 213 674 C193 674 180 669 180 660 C180 652 183 646 188 642 Z"
        fill="url(#shoeGradient)"
        filter="url(#objectShadow)"
      />
      <path
        d="M269 642 C288 637 310 637 324 642 C329 646 332 652 332 660 C332 669 319 674 299 674 C276 674 261 671 257 663 C252 654 258 645 269 642 Z"
        fill="url(#shoeGradient)"
        filter="url(#objectShadow)"
      />
      <path d="M190 664 Q220 674 251 664" stroke="#8E1F1F" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.5"/>
      <path d="M261 664 Q292 674 322 664" stroke="#8E1F1F" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.5"/>
    </g>

  </g>
</svg>
